details: For every nonempty finite class, the stronger bound $\mathrm Q_m(\mathcal H)\leq|\mathcal H|-1$ holds.
proof: Maintain the version space of candidates. While it has two distinct concepts, choose a coordinate on which two candidates disagree and make a membership query there. Whichever answer is returned eliminates at least one candidate. After at most $|\mathcal H|-1$ queries only the target remains.
name: Size / Membership Query Complexity
witness_verification: For #classes/full_cube with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $2^n$ and $n$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
